summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K covering two routine items: a renewal of its advisory agreement with Ares Commercial Real Estate Management LLC on substantially the same terms through April 30, 2027, and a monthly update on unregistered sales of equity securities under Regulation D, including Class S-PR, D-PR, and I-PR shares generating ~$36.1M in gross proceeds. No special-situation transaction such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing is a standard current report disclosing operations and capital raising.
